ground_truth.node_text: Mount a calibrated accelerometer on the front bearing housing with a flat washer stud or magnetic base. turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the vibration level below the alarm limit?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, both readings are within the acceptable zone and below the alarm threshold.

turns.utterance: Is the bearing temperature within the rated operating limit?

ground_truth.node_text: Bearing temperature within rated operating limit?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the bearing housings are running well within spec. Temperature rise is under twenty-five degrees and absolute temperature is below seventy.

ground_truth.node_text: Bearing temperature within rated operating limit?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the radial runout within two micrometer tolerance?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, I'm seeing runout at three point one micrometers. That's over the two micrometer limit.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the bearing preload via the locknut in quarter-turn increments.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Locknut adjusted by a quarter turn. Preload has been increased.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify the radial runout after the preload adjustment.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify radial runout after pre load adjustment

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I've made a second adjustment attempt and remeasured, but runout is still at two point eight micrometers. It's not coming into tolerance.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify radial runout after pre load adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Procedure complete. The runout is unrecoverable through adjustment. Escalate this issue immediately—bearing replacement is required before this spindle can return to service.
